Build the package like this:

R CMD INSTALL --no-multiarch Rhipe ....

https://github.com/saptarshiguha/RHIPE/wiki/Install-Hadoop-and-RHIPE-on-Mac-OS-X

I think this is where the problem starts. Full screen output is attached.
